resources.name: Open-source DFT software package

access.notes: Any open-source plane-wave or all-electron DFT code capable of static total energy calculations for periodic systems. Examples: Quantum ESPRESSO (https://www.quantum-espresso.org/), Elk (https://elk.sourceforge.io/).

resources.notes: The code must support fixed-atom single-point energy calculations.

resources.name: Crystallographic data for LLTO (y=0.21) from Zou & Inoue (2005)

access.notes: Journal article providing lattice parameters, atomic positions, and site occupancies for the P4/mmm LLTO structure at composition y=0.21.

resources.notes: Used to construct the three periodic structural models.
